source.citation: Bêty J, Giroux J-F, Gauthier G (2004) Individual variation in timing of migration: causes and reproductive consequences in greater snow geese (Anser caerulescens atlanticus). Behavioral Ecology and Sociobiology 57:1-8.
source.population: female greater snow geese, southern Quebec spring staging area to Bylot Island

ecological_interpretation: later departure can be partly offset by shorter migration duration; raw departure delay is not equivalent to downstream arrival delay

payoff_b_role.forbidden_reframing: do not convert the observed departure-duration correlation directly into D_eff or q_wait
